reason: Air volume is 500 + 350 - 800 = 50 cm3. As a share of the 350 cm3 soil sample that is 14.28% (C). The key's 6.25% divides by the 800 cm3 total instead.
Heat content is mass times specific heat capacity times temperature. Neither density nor volume appears directly, so A and D are both defensible and the item is ambiguous.
2000 W at 240 V draws 8.3 A. A fuse is chosen as the next standard rating above the working current, which is 13 A (C). The key gives the working current itself.
Croton, milk bush and ixora are normally raised from stem cuttings. Ice plant is raised from seed. Twelve of thirteen models rejected the key.
